scripts.build: wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/api && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.operator.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist/operator && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.portal.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist/portal && pnpm run build:production
scripts.build:production: pnpm run build:production:api && pnpm run build:production:operator-bootstrap && pnpm run build:production:operator && pnpm run build:production:portal
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run access:test && pnpm run inventory:check && pnpm run tax-rules:check && pnpm run tax-rules:test && pnpm run types:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src test scripts operator-ui operator-app portal-app README.md vitest.config.ts wrangler.jsonc wrangler.operator.jsonc wrangler.portal.jsonc wrangler.operator-bootstrap.jsonc wrangler.production.jsonc wrangler.operator-production-bootstrap.jsonc wrangler.operator-production.jsonc wrangler.portal-production.jsonc package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src test scripts operator-ui operator-app portal-app README.md vitest.config.ts wrangler.jsonc wrangler.operator.jsonc wrangler.portal.jsonc wrangler.operator-bootstrap.jsonc wrangler.production.jsonc wrangler.operator-production-bootstrap.jsonc wrangler.operator-production.jsonc wrangler.portal-production.jsonc package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --deny typescript/no-floating-promises src test scripts vitest.config.ts
scripts.types: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts && wrangler types --config wrangler.operator.jsonc --env-interface OperatorBindings --include-runtime false worker-configuration.operator.d.ts && wrangler types --config wrangler.portal.jsonc --env-interface PortalBindings --include-runtime false worker-configuration.portal.d.ts
scripts.types:check: wrangler types --check worker-configuration.d.ts && wrangler types --config wrangler.operator.jsonc --env-interface OperatorBindings --include-runtime false --check worker-configuration.operator.d.ts && wrangler types --config wrangler.portal.jsonc --env-interface PortalBindings --include-runtime false --check worker-configuration.portal.d.ts
